Shifts change every week. Your sleep, meals, and workouts shouldn't fall apart because of it.

So I built Clopen Proof, a free Grok Bot template. Type your shifts. It blocks sleep, places meals, protects wind-down, moves workouts, and flags short nights.https://t.co/Q9OFYI8S5r
